Ahrefs

Build search visibility around useful content and evidence.

AOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Ahrefs supports keyword research, backlink analysis, and website auditing. MoreSpace can turn those research signals into a reviewed SEO plan, linking technical improvements and content priorities with observed search outcomes while preserving the distinction between proprietary estimates and the client's actual business results.

Useful outputs

  • Keyword and page opportunity briefs with relevant source context
  • Reviewed technical and backlink findings with practical priorities
  • A reporting view separating estimated visibility from observed results

Where we can apply it

  • Priority service → keyword research → useful content brief → reviewed publication.
  • Audit issue → validation → implementation task → recrawl and resolution review.
  • Competitor research → opportunity shortlist → observed search outcomes → SEO roadmap.
01

Use case 1

Research search opportunities and competing pages for priority services.

02

Use case 2

Review backlink context and technical issues without promising ranking outcomes.

03

Use case 3

Create recurring research and performance views through eligible API access.

Inputs we need

  • Website domain, target geography, and service priorities
  • Approved competitor list and existing page or content inventory
  • Authorized project access and defined research questions

Delivery sequence

  • Define the commercial search questions and representative competing pages.
  • Review research and audit findings against actual site and customer needs.
  • Assign reviewed improvements and measure outcomes with appropriate source data.

Expert review points

  • Check the relevance and accuracy of findings before recommending changes.
  • Verify eligible API endpoints and avoid presenting proprietary scores as business results.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Google Search Console
  • Content workflows
  • Reporting tools
  • HTTP APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Organic clicks
  • Referring domains
  • Audit issues resolved
  • Organic lead conversion rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
